videos.title: Meet Google Fitbit Edge | Coaching, right when you need it
videos.summary: Introduces Google Fitbit Edge, a health and fitness wearable with Gemini-powered personal coaching, AFib-oriented heart monitoring, up to one-week battery, and pre-orders from $179.99.

videos.title: The new Apple HomeView: Keep the whole home connected, entertained, and in the know.
videos.summary: Launches Apple HomeView, a 7-inch smart display with multi-user recognition, Siri AI, Spatial Audio speakers, FaceTime, and HomeKit/Matter smart-home control.

videos.title: Welcome Apple HomeView: Designed for life at home.
videos.summary: Official campaign film for Apple HomeView, highlighting Spatial Audio, smart-home control, FaceTime, Siri AI, and personalized multi-user experiences at home.

videos.title: The new Apple TV 4K: The ultimate cinematic experience.
videos.summary: Unveils the new Apple TV 4K with Dolby Vision/HDR10+, Siri AI with far-field mics, Find My for the Siri Remote, and HomePod surround-sound home-theater pairing.

videos.title: The new HomePod mini 2: Rich, room-filling sound in a compact design.
videos.summary: Introduces HomePod mini 2 with richer room-filling sound, Siri AI for hands-free smart-home help, multiroom audio, and five color options.
